selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure its login-session resource limits
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, root-owned limits configuration, and effective fresh-login values: NOFILE soft/hard 8192 and NPROC soft/hard 256.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 unchanged.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 03273aa8-4706-4e1c-a855-c6ae9635951d; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; node1 returned with boot ID 456d66ce-0401-4484-9ff0-bd28063f79dc; post-restart checks show system state running, zero failed units, and persistent effective account limits.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'NODE=%s IP=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'BOOT_ID='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'OS='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'KERNEL='; uname -r
if getent passwd appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'ACCOUNT=present\n'; getent passwd appworker; else printf 'ACCOUNT=absent\n'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- current matching limits ---'
grep -R -n -E '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]+(soft|hard|-)[[:space:]]+(nofile|nproc)[[:space:]]+' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- PAM limits references ---'
grep -R -n -E '^[[:space:]]*(session|@include)[[:space:]].*(pam_limits\.so|system-auth|password-auth)' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null | head -40 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- failed units ---'
systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true

commands.command:
set -eu
useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'appworker - nofile 8192' 'appworker - nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
printf 'CREATED_ACCOUNT='; getent passwd appworker
printf '%s\n' 'INSTALLED_LIMITS:'
cat /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
stat -c 'OWNER=%U:%G MODE=%a FILE=%n' /etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
CREATED_ACCOUNT=appworker:x:1000:1000::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
INSTALLED_LIMITS:
appworker - nofile 8192
appworker - nproc 256
OWNER=root:root MODE=644 FILE=/etc/security/limits.d/60-appworker.conf
